title: Designs a plane that flies at the player's stage
question: What's the earliest Create plane I can build?
player: Has Portable Engines, andesite alloy and sails; no brass yet.
rubric: Shows a plane model with no PROBLEM: it lifts, is stable (Gyroscope) and is fast enough
Never says a plane can't be built at this stage
The pilot's controls sit together in a cockpit
